intro.zh: 一页看完六大激素：怎么合成、怎么运、谁接收、做什么。点激素名字可以跳到那一章。
intro.en: The six hormones on one page: how they are made and moved, what receives them and what they do. Tap a name to open its chapter.
intro.ms: Enam hormon dalam satu halaman: bagaimana ia dibuat dan diangkut, apa yang menerimanya dan apa yang dilakukannya. Ketik nama untuk membuka babnya.

chem.zh: 吲哚化合物，主要是 IAA

made.zh: 色氨酸依赖与不依赖途径；茎尖、幼叶
made.en: Tryptophan-dependent and -independent routes; shoot apex, young leaves
made.ms: Laluan bergantung dan tidak bergantung triptofan; apeks pucuk, daun muda

move.zh: 细胞到细胞的极性运输（AUX1 进、PIN 出）
move.en: Cell-to-cell polar transport (AUX1 in, PIN out)
move.ms: Pengangkutan berkutub sel ke sel (AUX1 masuk, PIN keluar)

receptor.zh: TIR1（SCF 的 F-box）→ AUX/IAA 降解 → ARF
receptor.en: TIR1 (F-box of SCF) → AUX/IAA destroyed → ARF

does.zh: 细胞伸长（酸生长）、向性、顶端优势、维管分化、不定根
does.en: Cell elongation (acid growth), tropisms, apical dominance, vascular differentiation, adventitious roots
does.ms: Pemanjangan sel (pertumbuhan asid), tropisme, dominasi apeks, pembezaan vaskular, akar adventitis

tools.en: NAA, IBA, 2,4-D; transport inhibitors TIBA, NPA
tools.ms: NAA, IBA, 2,4-D; perencat pengangkutan TIBA, NPA

made.zh: GGPP → 内根-贝壳杉烯 → GA₁₂；种子、幼叶、根尖
made.en: GGPP → ent-kaurene → GA₁₂; seeds, young leaves, root tips
made.ms: GGPP → ent-kaurena → GA₁₂; biji, daun muda, hujung akar

receptor.zh: GID1 → DELLA 被 SCF^SLY1/GID2 降解

does.zh: 节间伸长、抽薹、种子萌发（α-淀粉酶）、果实发育
does.en: Internode elongation, bolting, germination (α-amylase), fruit growth
does.ms: Pemanjangan ruas, pembentukan batang bunga, percambahan (α-amilase), pertumbuhan buah

tools.zh: GA₃；合成抑制剂 CCC、AMO-1618、Phosfon D、嘧啶醇、BX-112
tools.en: GA₃; synthesis inhibitors CCC, AMO-1618, Phosfon D, ancymidol, BX-112
tools.ms: GA₃; perencat sintesis CCC, AMO-1618, Phosfon D, ansimidol, BX-112

chem.zh: N⁶ 取代腺嘌呤：玉米素、iP；合成的激动素、BA
chem.en: N⁶-substituted adenines: zeatin, iP; synthetic kinetin, BA
chem.ms: Adenina tertukar ganti N⁶: zeatin, iP; kinetin sintetik, BA

made.zh: IPT（限速）把异戊烯基接到 AMP；主要在根尖
made.en: IPT (rate-limiting) adds isopentenyl to AMP; mainly root tips
made.ms: IPT (pengehad kadar) menambah isopentenil kepada AMP; terutamanya hujung akar

receptor.zh: CRE1/AHK4、AHK2、AHK3 双组分 → AHP → B 型 ARR
receptor.en: CRE1/AHK4, AHK2, AHK3 two-component → AHP → type-B ARR
receptor.ms: CRE1/AHK4, AHK2, AHK3 dua komponen → AHP → ARR jenis B

does.zh: 与生长素一起促进分裂、组织培养长芽、延缓衰老、养分吸引、维持分生组织
does.en: Division with auxin, shoots in culture, delays senescence, attracts nutrients, maintains meristems
does.ms: Pembahagian bersama auksin, pucuk dalam kultur, melambatkan penuaan, menarik nutrien, mengekalkan meristem

made.zh: 紫黄质经 NCED 切成黄氧素 → ABA；成熟叶、保卫细胞、维管组织
made.en: Violaxanthin cut by NCED to xanthoxin → ABA; mature leaves, guard cells, vascular tissue
made.ms: Violaxantin dipotong oleh NCED kepada xantoksin → ABA; daun matang, sel pengawal, tisu vaskular

move.zh: 移动性高；根经木质部送到叶（干旱信号）
move.en: Highly mobile; root to shoot in xylem (drought signal)
move.ms: Sangat mudah bergerak; akar ke pucuk dalam xilem (isyarat kemarau)

receptor.zh: PYR/PYL/RCAR → 抑制 PP2C → SnRK2 活化

does.zh: 气孔关闭、种子休眠、防止胎萌、逆境耐受
does.en: Stomatal closure, seed dormancy, preventing vivipary, stress tolerance
does.ms: Penutupan stoma, dorman biji, mencegah viviparti, toleransi tekanan

tools.zh: 代谢成红花菜豆酸、二氢红花菜豆酸
tools.en: Inactivated to phaseic and dihydrophaseic acid
tools.ms: Dinyahaktifkan kepada asid faseik dan dihidrofaseik

made.zh: Met → SAM（SAM 合成酶）→ ACC（ACC 合成酶，限速）→ 乙烯（ACC 氧化酶）；Yang 循环
made.en: Met → SAM (SAM synthetase) → ACC (ACC synthase, rate-limiting) → ethylene (ACC oxidase); Yang cycle
made.ms: Met → SAM (SAM sintetase) → ACC (ACC sintase, pengehad kadar) → etilena (ACC oksidase); kitaran Yang

receptor.zh: ETR1 等（内质网，含铜）；无乙烯时经 CTR1 抑制反应
receptor.en: ETR1 family (ER, copper); represses via CTR1 when ethylene is absent
receptor.ms: Keluarga ETR1 (RE, kuprum); menindas melalui CTR1 apabila etilena tiada

does.zh: 果实成熟（跃变）、衰老、三重反应、偏上生长、脱落
does.en: Ripening (climacteric), senescence, triple response, epinasty, abscission
does.ms: Pemasakan (klimakterik), penuaan, tindak balas tiga serangkai, epinasti, keguguran

chem.zh: 植物甾醇激素，主要是油菜素内酯

made.zh: 鲨烯 → 环阿屯醇 → 菜油甾醇 → 油菜素内酯

receptor.zh: 质膜 BRI1 + BAK1 → BIN2 被抑制 → BZR1 进核
receptor.en: Plasma-membrane BRI1 + BAK1 → BIN2 inhibited → BZR1 to nucleus
receptor.ms: BRI1 + BAK1 membran plasma → BIN2 direncat → BZR1 ke nukleus

does.zh: 茎和花粉管伸长、细胞分裂、萌发、维管分化；抑制根伸长
does.en: Stem and pollen-tube elongation, division, germination, vascular differentiation; inhibits root elongation
does.ms: Pemanjangan batang dan tiub debunga, pembahagian, percambahan, pembezaan vaskular; merencat pemanjangan akar
